reviews.text: Elena is perfect. This is the second time she's looked after my cats, and I truly leave with complete peace of mind. She also looks after my dog ​​when I have to be away for an appointment or longer, and she comes to my house and spoils him rotten while I'm away. Elena has become indispensable in my life with my pets because I trust her completely.

For three weeks, Elena walked our dog Voyou three times a week, and everything went perfectly. Gentle, warm, and attentive, she really takes the time to go on lovely walks and meet the needs of our four-legged friends. I recommend her without hesitation!

Once a week we entrust our dog to Elena for walking and we are extremely pleased with her service.

We highly recommend her.
Elena walks my little Shiba, it goes super well, he is calm when he comes home, I recommend it!
I regularly leave my dog ​​Bernard with Elena for walks, nothing to complain about, great service! My dog ​​loves her.

We contacted Elena on a friend's recommendation to look after our cat Milo while we were away on vacation. Elena came to feed him and play with him for the entire duration of our stay. We were reassured knowing our cat was in good hands and we would definitely use her services again ☺️ Thank you, Elena!
Thank you to Elena for taking care of my dog ​​Fripouille. I've seen a real improvement since the beginning of the sessions; he's much less stressed than before! Thank you again! 🤩 🙏 …

Elena is very professional and friendly; it's always a pleasure to use her services to walk my little dog. She takes excellent care of him, and it's such a luxury to be able to leave him in her care without any worries.
I highly recommend her! 🙏🏼 …

Elena was incredibly patient with my dog ​​Philibert, who had been very stressed since I moved to Marseille.

I quickly saw a significant improvement in his behavior with each walk. Thank you again! ☺️
Absolutely perfect! I leave my dog ​​with Elena twice a week for walks, and he comes back calm and well-fed. I recommend it 100%!
